no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee meeting was not needed for this application because two drugs of the same class are already approved, and there were no issues that needed input from an advisory committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for XADAGO (safinamide, NDA207145). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Deputy Office Director Decisional Memo, and Medical Review) all state that an AdComm was unnecessary because safinamide is a selective MAO-B inhibitor of the same class as two already-approved drugs (rasagiline and selegiline) for the identical Parkinson's disease population, and no safety or effectiveness issues required committee input. Because no AdComm was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
